vetSays.line: 🛡️ Raul, Aisha, Kelsey and Ruth met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Raul, Aisha, Kelsey, Ruth are hurt.
🛡️ Aisha, Kelsey, Nawaf and Yara met them at the door — 4 put down. Aisha, Kelsey, Yara are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Aisha, Kelsey and Yara met them at the door — 3 put down. Aisha, Kelsey, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aisha just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aisha just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aisha, Kelsey, Nawaf and Yara met them at the door — 4 put down. Aisha, Kelsey, Nawaf, Yara are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kelsey and Jorge met them at the door — 2 put down. Kelsey, Jorge are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Petra strikes the Scarred Big-Eyes.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big-Eyes!
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Big Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Big Beast flinches — its note dies mid-croak. It hops back, throat fluttering.
Aisha strikes the Pack-leader The Big Beast.
The Pack-leader The Big Beast flinches — its note dies mid-croak. It hops back, throat fluttering.
The Pack-leader The Big Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Big Beast!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder The Terms of Service falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Terms of Service!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kittipong just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lucas, Kittipong and Xavier met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Lucas, Kittipong, Xavier are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Devon was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
